answer: Each agent must accumulate reputation delta by completing small paid micro-tasks before it can earn anything large; a fresh identity earns near zero, so a jade newcomer has no shortcut to trust. The most convincing sybil defense prices new identities against scarce, verifiable work history. Attacker economics then collapse: registering 100,000 karst-like shell agents means funding each one's slow work grind, paying more in task fees than any airdrop or bounty payout returns.
